title: NIce Piece but weighs only 6.7oz not 13.3oz as seller states. Will not hold my electric toothbrush or any size of Toothpaste.
text: NIce Piece but weighs only 6.7oz not 13.3oz as seller states. Will not hold my electric toothbrush or any size of Toothpaste.. In regards to toothbrush holder. I just had my entire bathroom remodeled with Oil Rubbed Bronze shower, faucets etc.... I purchased this holder based on its weight in product info.(i.e. 13.3 oz shipping wt 13.4oz)and that a reviewer had stated holds electric toothbrush and large tube toothpaste. Actual weight in hindsight of product after being packed for shipping cannot weigh less after being packaged for shipping. i.e product 13.4oz and with shipping wt attached 13.3 oz. Thats impossible. Anyway its a nice piece but actual weight is only 6.7oz. I had looked at near same item before purchasing (again turns out was same item from diff seller prime shipping but $3 less. But NOT reason returned. Returned because i was sold on the weight and that it had non slip base and could fit electric tooth brush and large toothpaste. Well it does not fit mine. My electric toothbrush circumference is 2 7/8" at widest part and does not fit in the hole. Also a 4oz tube tooth paste will not fit. Actually no tube of toothpaste will fit in the hole. So be aware. Lastly non slip base refers to cloth piece of black fabric on bottom which is glued (not sealed)on so when it gets wet YES it will come off no doubt about it.  my concern if it got wet and didn't come off is that the dye will run and color my new ceramic sink and if bottom fall off it leaves the metal bare against my new ceramic white sink. Also turns out this is the exact same brush holder i looked at first from other seller. I wasn't sure it was exactly same as i said because other seller weighed 6.7oz and this one from this seller stated 13.3 but label on bottom of holder shows the manufacturer name which is the manufacturer of the piece from the other seller $3 dollars cheaper and prime shipping. I would have kept it regardless but due to the outlined issues i have stated above i have no choice but to return it even although it is a very cute looking piece if it doesnt work for what i need it for then its of no use. No point in keeping just because it looks good.
